৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১) Which enzyme is predominantly elevated in cholestatic liver disease?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

Cholestatic Pattern 
• ALP* and GGT increase.
 • Causes: Biliary obstruction, CBD stone.

Hepatocellular Pattern
 • ALT and AST increase.
 • ALT is more liver-specific.

Prehepatic (Haemolysis) 
• Unconjugated bilirubin increases. 
• ALT and AST remain normal.

Alcoholic Liver Disease
 • AST/ALT ratio usually altered.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২) Which of the following is a characteristic clinical feature of insulin resistance?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:
• Acanthosis nigricans is a direct physical marker of insulin resistance and high circulating insulin levels.
• In contrast, diabetic dermopathy, necrobiosis lipoidica and cheiroarthropathy are diabetic manifestations that may occur in both type 1 & type 2 diabetes; they are not specific markers of insulin resistance.

Acanthosis nigricans:
• Velvety, hyperpigmented thickening of skin, especially over the neck and axillae.
• Most commonly associated with insulin resistance.
• Commonly seen in type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity.
• May occur in gastric carcinoma (malignant acanthosis nigricans).

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩) Which of the following is a common causative organism of reactive arthritis?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
• Reactive arthritis is a sterile inflammatory spondyloarthritis.
• Usually develops 1–4 weeks after infection.
• Classic genitourinary trigger → Chlamydia trachomatis.

Common Triggers
• Genitourinary: Chlamydia trachomatis
• Gastrointestinal : Campylobacter, Salmonella, Shigella.

Joint pattern
• Asymmetric oligoarthritis
• Predominantly lower limbs

Classic triad
• Arthritis
• Urethritis/cervicitis
• Conjunctivitis

• Genetic association : Human leukocyte antigen-B27

HBeAg positivity indicates active viral replication and high infectivity.

HBV Serology : 
HBsAg: Current HBV infection.
HBeAg: Active viral replication and high infectivity.
Anti-HBs: Immunity against HBV.
Anti-HBc IgM: Acute or recent infection.
Anti-HBc IgG: Previous exposure or chronic infection.
Anti-HBe: Usually reduced viral replication and infectivity.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৮) Which antithyroid drug is preferred during the first trimester of pregnancy?

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৯) Which of the following is the classic X-ray finding in ankylosing spondylitis?

Bamboo spine results from marginal syndesmophyte formation and bridging of adjacent vertebrae.

Ankylosing Spondylitis
• Sacroiliitis → hallmark early radiographic finding
• Bamboo spine → classic X-ray finding

Specific X-ray Findings
• RA → Marginal erosions + periarticular osteopenia
• OA → Osteophytes + joint-space narrowing
• AS → Bamboo spine
• PsA → Pencil-in-cup deformity

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১০) The most common site of involvement in abdominal tuberculosis is:

The ileocecal region is the most common site of intestinal tuberculosis.

Common Sites of Involvement :
Abdominal tuberculosis — Ileocecal region
Enteric fever — Terminal ileum (Peyer’s patches)
Crohn’s disease — Terminal ileum
Ulcerative colitis — Rectum
Coeliac disease — Duodenum and proximal jejunum

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১১) Which of the following is an incretin mimetic?

Sitagliptin, vildagliptin, saxagliptin, linagliptin, alogliptin.

SGLT2 inhibitor : Empagliflozin

α-glucosidase inhibitor: Acarbose.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১২) What is the most common electrolyte abnormality in acute kidney injury ?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

• Cause :  Reduced renal potassium excretion → potassium retention.

• Clinical importance
 • Severe hyperkalaemia may cause fatal cardiac arrhythmias.
 • ECG: Tall, peaked T waves; widening of QRS in severe cases.
 • Hyperkalaemia is a life-threatening complication of AKI.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৩) Which is the most useful initial investigation for assessing thyroid function?

Explanation:
TSH is the most sensitive initial test for thyroid dysfunction.
Abnormal TSH → Measure free T₄, with free T₃ when indicated.
? Key Point: TSH is the first-line test for thyroid function.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৪) A patient with acromegaly has an increased risk of which of the following malignancies?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Malignant Disease Associations

• Acromegaly → Colorectal carcinoma
• Hashimoto thyroiditis → Primary thyroid lymphoma
• Down syndrome → Acute leukemia (ALL, AML-M7)
• Klinefelter syndrome → Male breast carcinoma
• Turner syndrome → Gonadoblastoma
• MEN 2A/2B → Medullary thyroid carcinoma
• Sjögren syndrome → MALT lymphoma
• Celiac disease → Enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma (EATL)

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৫) Which is a suitable antibiotic for uncomplicated UTI at term pregnancy?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:
UTI in pregnancy: Nitrofurantoin or cephalexin for 7 days.
At term: Avoid nitrofurantoin.
Avoid: Trimethoprim particularly in the first trimester and quinolones in pregnancy.
UTI at term → Cephalexin is a suitable drug of choice.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৬) Which antibody is most commonly associated with Hashimoto thyroiditis?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

- Anti-thyroid peroxidase (Anti-TPO) antibodies are present in 90–100% of autoimmune hypothyroidism cases.

Thyroid Antibodies

Anti-TPO
Anti-thyroid peroxidase antibody
Seen in Hashimoto thyroiditis: 90–100%

Anti-Tg
Anti-thyroglobulin antibody
Seen in Hashimoto thyroiditis: 80–90%

TRAb
TSH-receptor antibody
Seen in Graves’ disease: >95% (stimulating antibodies)

TSH-receptor blocking antibody
Causes hypothyroidism in autoimmune thyroid disease.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৭) Which of the following is the most commonly affected large joint in osteoarthritis?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
The knee is the most commonly affected large, weight-bearing joint in osteoarthritis.

Common Joint Involvements in Osteoarthritis
• Knee → commonest large joint
• Hand → DIP (Heberden nodes), PIP (Bouchard nodes), 1st CMC
• Spine → cervical and lumbar regions

“Most Common Joint" Associations
• Osteoarthritis → Knee
• Acute gout → 1st MTP (podagra)
• Rheumatoid arthritis → MCP & PIP; spares DIP
• Psoriatic arthritis → DIP
• Ankylosing spondylitis → Sacroiliac joints
• Pseudogout (CPPD) → Knee
• Septic arthritis → Knee
• Löfgren syndrome (acute sarcoidosis) → Ankles

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৮) Which diagnostic criteria are used for IBS?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation

• Rome IV → Recurrent abdominal pain ≥1 day/week over the last 3 months.
• Associated with ≥2: defecation, change in stool frequency, or change in stool form.
• Symptom onset ≥6 months before diagnosis.

Important Diagnostic Criteria :
• Jones criteria → Acute rheumatic fever
• Duke criteria → Infective endocarditis
• Rome IV → IBS
• Ranson → Acute pancreatitis severity
• CURB-65 → Pneumonia severity
• Wells score → DVT / PE probability
• Child–Pugh → Cirrhosis severity
• ACR/EULAR → Rheumatoid arthritis classification
• Light’s criteria → Pleural effusion: exudate vs transudate
• KDIGO → AKI definition and staging

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ১৯) What is the most common cause of sterile pyuria?

Explanation:
Sterile pyuria:
Urinary WBCs with negative routine bacterial culture.
Renal tuberculosis is a classic cause.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২০) Which of the following drugs is a common cause of drug-induced gout?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation

• Pyrazinamide → ↓ renal uric acid excretion → hyperuricemia → gout.

• It is a classic drug-associated cause of hyperuricemia.

Important Drugs Causing Hyperuricemia

• Pyrazinamide
• Hydrochlorothiazide
• Loop diuretics
• Frusemide
• Cyclosporine

Drugs That Reduce Uric Acid

• Losartan
• Uricosuric effect
• Allopurinol
• Xanthine oxidase inhibitor
• Febuxostat
• Xanthine oxidase inhibitor
• Rasburicase
• Converts uric acid to allantoin

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

Hydroxychloroquine can cause retinal toxicity.
Regular ophthalmological screening detects retinopathy early.

Metformin improves insulin sensitivity and reduces hepatic glucose production.

Insulin Sensitizers:
Biguanides: Metformin.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৩) Which is the most common type of thyroid carcinoma?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:
Papillary carcinoma: Most common thyroid cancer (about 80–85%).
Commonly spreads via lymphatics to cervical lymph nodes.
Popular = papillary

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৪) Vitamin B12 deficiency suggests pathology at which site?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
Vitamin B12 deficiency suggests terminal ileal disease because the B12–intrinsic factor complex is absorbed in the terminal ileum.


B12 absorption:
• B12 binds intrinsic factor secreted by gastric parietal cells.
• B12–intrinsic factor complex is absorbed in the terminal ileum via cubam receptors.
• Crohn’s disease or ileal resection → B12 malabsorption.
• Pernicious anaemia → intrinsic factor deficiency.
• Deficiency causes megaloblastic anaemia and neurological abnormalities.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৫) Which clinical sign is associated with severe acute pancreatitis?

Explanation

• Grey Turner’s sign → Flank bruising due to retroperitoneal haemorrhage.
• Cullen’s sign → Periumbilical bruising due to intra-abdominal bleeding.
• Murphy’s sign → Acute cholecystitis.
• McBurney’s sign → Acute appendicitis.
• Both Cullen’s and Grey Turner’s signs suggest severe haemorrhagic pancreatitis.

Explanation:

• Urine culture: Identifies the causative organism.
• Sensitivity: Determines antibiotic susceptibility.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৭) Which feature is most characteristic of primary adrenal insufficiency?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:

• Postural hypotension
• Weight loss
• Fatigue

- Primary adrenal insufficiency

- Secondary adrenal insufficiency

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৮) Which serum tumour marker is associated with hepatocellular carcinoma?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation:
Tumour Markers
• AFP: HCC and yolk sac tumours.
• CEA: Colorectal carcinoma and liver metastases.
• CA 19-9: Pancreatic and cholangiocarcinoma.
• CA-125: ovarian carcinoma

Clinical Role in HCC
• Markedly elevated AFP supports the diagnosis.
• Normal AFP does not exclude HCC.
• Diagnosis relies on multiphase contrast-enhanced CT or MRI showing arterial hyperenhancement and venous washout.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ২৯) Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line DMARD for rheumatoid arthritis?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

• RA → Methotrexate

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩০) Which drug is used to reduce proteinuria in diabetic kidney disease?

• Example: Enalapril.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩১) Which antidiabetic drug is most associated with weight gain?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

Weight Gain
• Insulin
• Sulfonylureas
• Pioglitazone

Weight Loss

Weight Neutral

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩২) Persistent elevation of serum amylase beyond 1 week after acute pancreatitis most suggests:

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৩) Which is a hallmark feature of type 2 diabetes mellitus?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp: Explanation: Glycosuria is a hallmark feature of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Polyuria results from osmotic diuresis, proteinuria indicates diabetic nephropathy, and ketonuria is characteristic of DKA.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৪) Which is the drug of choice for uncomplicated cirrhotic ascites?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:

Inhibits aldosterone, increasing sodium and water excretion.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৫) What is the cardinal feature of malabsorption syndrome?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
•Impaired fat digestion or absorption causes bulky, pale, greasy, foul-smelling stools that float and are difficult to flush.

Other features: 
• Vitamin A: Night blindness, xerophthalmia.
• Vitamin D + calcium: Osteomalacia, bone pain, tetany.
• Vitamin E: Ataxia, Haemolytic anaemia.
• Vitamin K: Prolonged PT/INR.
• Iron, folate, B12: Microcytic or macrocytic anaemia.
• Protein: Hypoalbuminaemia, oedema.

Explanation:
Rheumatoid nodules:
Common extra-articular manifestation, usually over the elbows.

Anterior uveitis: Associated with HLA-B27 spondyloarthropathies.

Heberden nodes: Osteoarthritis of DIP joints.

Z deformity: Articular deformity of the thumb in RA.

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৩৮) Which urinary finding is most characteristic of glomerulonephritis?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
• Red blood cell casts → indicate glomerular bleeding → strongly suggest glomerulonephritis.
• Dysmorphic red blood cells on phase-contrast microscopy → suggest a glomerular source of hematuria.

Remember :
RBC casts / Dysmorphic RBCs: Glomerulonephritis / Glomerular haematuria
WBC casts: Acute pyelonephritis, Acute interstitial nephritis (AIN)
Muddy brown granular casts / Renal tubular epithelial casts: Acute tubular necrosis
Fatty casts / Oval fat bodies: Nephrotic syndrome

৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.question: ৪০) Which of the following is a characteristic clinical feature of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA)?
৫১তম স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - মেডিকে.exp:
Explanation
Kussmaul breathing is deep, rapid breathing that occurs as respiratory compensation for the metabolic acidosis of DKA.

Diabetic Ketoacidosis
Symptoms
• Polyuria & polydipsia
• Nausea & vomiting
• Abdominal pain
• Weakness/fatigue
• Drowsiness → altered consciousness

Sign:
• Dehydration
• Kussmaul breathing
• Fruity/acetone breath
• Tachycardia
• Hypotension

Biochemical Findings
• Hyperglycaemia
• Ketonaemia / ketonuria — hallmark
• High-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
• ↓ pH
• ↓ HCO₃⁻
• ↑ Anion gap
• K⁺ may be normal/high initially despite total-body K⁺ depletion
